z-m-38-05.title: Uma siphindaphinda imisebenzi emibili ekhulayo, ingabe umkhiqizo uhlala ukhula nawo?
z-m-38-05.topic: Imisebenzi ekhulayo nemikhiqizo: ukwakha izibonelo eziphikisayo ngemikhiqizo yemisebenzi ye-linear, nemibandela lapho isimangalo sibamba khona
z-m-38-05.goal: Hlola isimangalo “umkhiqizo wemisebenzi emibili ekhulayo uyakhula,” wakhe izibonelo eziphikisayo ezihlukene ngemisebenzi ye-linear, futhi ukhethe imibandela lapho isimangalo sibamba khona.
z-m-38-05.material: Kukhona imisebenzi emibili u-f no-g enomkhakha wezinombolo zangempela zonke. “Ekhulayo” kusho ukuthi uma x₁ < x₂, khona-ke f(x₁) < f(x₂). USeoa wathi, “Uma u-f no-g bobabili bemisebenzi ekhulayo, khona-ke umkhiqizo u-h(x) = f(x)·g(x) nawo uyimisebenzi ekhulayo.” USeoa wathatha u-f(x) = x + 1 no-g(x) = 2x + 1 futhi wabala u-h ku-x = 1, 2, 3. h(1) = 6, h(2) = 15, h(3) = 28.
z-m-38-05.thinking.0: Ukuhlola isimangalo (ukungasimemezeli sisiyiqiniso kusukela ezibonelweni ezimbalwa)
z-m-38-05.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa izibonelo eziphikisayo ukuhlunga nokukhetha imibandela lapho ibamba khona

z-m-38-05.prereq.3: Iqiniso lokuthi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele ukubonisa ukuthi isimangalo asilungile

z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.a: Welule iqiniso lokuthi amanani amathathu akhulile ukuya kuyo yonke i-domain. Ukuze umsebenzi ukhule, kumele kusebenze kuwo wonke u-x₁<x₂.

z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo sihlukanisa ibanga elihloliwe ne-domain yonke futhi sinquma ukuthi lapho kufanele kuhlolwe kabanzi khona.

z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.d: Unake ukuthi amanani akhula kangakanani. Lokho isimangalo sikushoyo akukhulumi ngosayizi wokukhula kodwa ngokukhula ku-x ngamunye.

z-m-38-05.s.s2.prompt: U-f(x) = x + m no-g(x) = x + n (m ≤ n) bobabili bangemisebenzi ekhulayo. Manje yenza izibonelo lapho umkhiqizo u-h(x) = f(x)·g(x) ungakhuli. Okungukuthi, yenza u-h(p) > h(q) kwizinombolo ezimbili ezithile u-p < q. Yenza izibonelo ezi-3 ezinama-(m, n) ahlukile.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ngemuva kokukhetha u-m no-n, yenza ithebula lamanani luka-h(x) ku-x = −3, −2, −1, 0, 1 bese ufuna indawo lapho amanani ehla khona.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.1: Uma uthola indawo lapho amanani ehla khona, bhala la manani amabili luka-x njengo-p no-q. Shintsha u-m no-n bese uhlola ukuthi ezinye (m, n) nazo zinendawo lapho amanani ehla khona.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c1: U-m akakhulu kuno-n (ukuze ipheya yemisebenzi efanayo ingabalwa kabili ngokushintshanisa amagama kuphela).

Uma u-f(x) = x + 1 no-g(x) = x + 3 (m = 1, n = 3), khona-ke u-h(−3) = (−2)(0) = 0 > h(−2) = (−1)(1) = −1. Isibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa sanele ukuphula isimangalo. Lapho amanani ezisho ezimbili eziqondile enegethivu, usayizi womkhiqizo ungaba mncane njengoba u-x ekhula.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.prompt: Sifuna ukwengeza isimo ukuze isimangalo sikaSeoa sihlale sisebenza. Yiluphi isimo esifanele?

z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.a: Amagrafu luka-f no-g bobabili adlula ekuqaleni futhi ayakhuphuka aye phezulu kwesokudla
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.a: U-f(x) = g(x) = x ungumsebenzi okhulayo odlula ekuqaleni, kodwa u-h(x) = x² uyehla ku-x < 0. Awuzange wakhe isibonelo esiphikisayo ukuhlola.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.b: Amanani omsebenzi u-f(0) no-g(0) ku-x = 0 womabili ayiphozithivu
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.b: Uphutheke ukuthi ingaba yiphozithivu ku-x = 0 kuphela futhi inegethivu kwa-x abanye. Hlola ngo-f(x) = g(x) = x + 1 ku-x = −3, −2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.c: Cabanga ngo-domain encishiswe yaba yingxenye lapho u-x > 0
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.c: Noma i-domain iyiphozithivu, amanani omsebenzi angaba nenegethivu. Hlola ngo-f(x) = g(x) = x − 5 ku-x = 1, 2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.d: Ku-x ngamunye ku-domain, u-f(x) no-g(x) bobabili beyiphozithivu
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.d: Le nketho ihlukanisa i-domain namanani omsebenzi futhi iqaphela ukuthi izimpawu zezinombolo eziphindaphindwayo ziyabalulekile lapho kuqhathaniswa imikhiqizo.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.explain: Uma u-p < q, khona-ke u-0 < f(p) < f(q) no-0 < g(p) < g(q), ngakho u-f(p)g(p) < f(q)g(p) < f(q)g(q). z-m-38-01.title: Njengoba sandisa ibanga, okuphezulu nokuncane kakhulu kuhamba kanjani?
z-m-38-01.topic: Okuphezulu nokuncane kakhulu komsebenzi we-quadratic uma ibanga lishintsha
z-m-38-01.goal: Njengoba isiphetho k sebanga sishintsha, hlola ngamathebula amanani ukuthi indawo lapho okuphezulu nokuncane kakhulu kwenzeka khona (i-vertex noma isiphetho) ishintsha kanjani, bese ubuyisela isibikezelo sakho sokuqala.
z-m-38-01.material: Nansi umsebenzi we-quadratic f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 (fundwa: 'x squared minus 4x plus 3'). Setha ibanga libe ngu-0 ≤ x ≤ k (k inombolo yangempela eyiphozithivu), shintsha u-k, bese ubheka okuphezulu nokuncane kakhulu kuka-f kuleli banga. U-Seoyeon wabikezela: “Uma isikhawu siba sibanzi, okuncane kakhulu kuba kuncane nakakhulu futhi okuphezulu kuba kukhulu nakakhulu.” Amathebula amanani ayembulwa eyodwa ngesikhathi, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
z-m-38-01.thinking.0: Hlola isibikezelo usebenzisa amathebula amanani njengobufakazi
z-m-38-01.thinking.1: Gcina noma uvuselele isinqumo sakho njengoba kufika ulwazi olusha
z-m-38-01.thinking.2: Sho, usebenzisa izikhawu, ukuthi isiphetho sishintsha kanjani uma isimo (ibanga) sishintsha
z-m-38-01.prereq.0: I-H1 yalo msebenzi iyizinga lobunzima elabelwe ekukhiqizeni kuphela; akusho ukuthi ikharikhulamu ibeka lokhu okuqukethwe eBangeni 1 lesikole esiphakeme. Cabanga ukuthi izidingo ezingezansi sezivele zifundiwe.
z-m-38-01.prereq.1: Ukubhala kabusha umsebenzi we-quadratic ngohlobo y=a(x−p)²+q ukuthola i-vertex (ukuqedela isikwele)
z-m-38-01.prereq.2: Isimo segrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic ne-axis yayo ye-symmetry
z-m-38-01.prereq.3: Ukubala wena amanani omsebenzi ukwenza ithebula lamanani
z-m-38-01.s.s1.prompt: Amathebula amanani ayembulwa eyodwa ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, yenza isinqumo kusuka kudatha yamanje, futhi uma kuvela idatha elandelayo, gcina noma uvuselele lowo mqondo. (Ibanga lihlala lingu-0 ≤ x ≤ k.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala phansi amapheya ka-x no-f(x) kusuka ethebuleni elembuliwe, bese uphawula lapho amanani amancane nawo amakhulu kakhulu enzeka khona.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala kabusha u-f(x) ngohlobo (x−□)²+□, bese uhlola ukuthi x lapho inani elincane kakhulu lenzeka khona kulolo hlobo lisebangeni yini.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Lithebula lamanani ka-k = 1 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1). Uma x = 0, f = 3; uma x = 0.5, f = 1.25; uma x = 1, f = 0. Kuleli bhange okuncane kakhulu ngu-0 futhi okuphezulu kakhulu ngu-3.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uma siqhubeka nokwandisa u-k ngale kuka-1, ucabanga ukuthi kuzokwenzeka ini ekuncaneni kakhulu? (Bikezela usebenzisa amathebula nefomula kuze kube manje kuphela.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngamathebula amathathu kuphela, kokubili a no-b kungabikezelo ezingenzeka. Uma ucabange ngesimo sefomula (ivulekela phezulu), b iyinto yemvelo; uma ubheke kuphela ukuthambekela kwamanani aya encipha, uthola a. Ake siyihlole ngethebula elilandelayo.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Njengoba k inyuka, okuncane kakhulu kuqhubeka nokuba kuncane
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqhubeke kusukela ekuthambekeleni kwamanani aya encipha kuphela. Umsebenzi we-quadratic ushintsha isiqondiso endaweni ethile, ngakho udinga ukuhlola ukuthi leyo ndawo isesikhawini yini.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kusukela ku-k othile, kungase kuyeke ukuncipha
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi sibikezelo sivela ekukhumbuleni ukuthi igrafu ivulekela phezulu, ngakho inephoyinti eliphansi kakhulu. Ukuthi leli phoyinti eliphansi kakhulu liphi kumele kuhlolwe ngethebula.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Noma k iyini, okuncane kakhulu kuhlala kungu-0
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ubheke kuphela amanani angaphakathi kwesikhawu futhi awucabanganga ngamanani angaphandle. Uma isikhawu siba sibanzi, amanani amasha ka-x ayangena.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Lithebula lamanani ka-k = 3 (0 ≤ x ≤ 3). Uma x = 1, f = 0; uma x = 2, f = −1; uma x = 3, f = 0. Futhi, uma x = 2.5, f = −0.75. Okuncane kakhulu ngu-−1.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uma siqhubeka nokwandisa u-k, ku-k = 5 noma k = 10, kuzokwenzeka ini ekuncaneni kakhulu?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Njengoba f(x) = (x−2)² − 1, inani eliphansi kakhulu u-−1 lenzeka ku-x = 2, futhi kubo x omkhulu kuno-2 amanani ayaphinda aphakame. Ngakho noma nini lapho k ingu-2 noma ngaphezulu, okuncane kakhulu kufana, u-−1. Uma ukhethe a kuqala, khomba ithebula elishintshe isibikezelo sakho.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuqapheli ukuthi amanani ayaphinda aphakame ngemva kokudlula x = 2. Qhathanisa amanani ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kuka-x = 2 ethebuleni.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sifunda ethebuleni ukuthi inani liphansi kakhulu ku-x = 2 futhi liyaphakama ngemva kwalokho.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kusukela ku-k = 3, okuncane kakhulu empeleni kuyakhula
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uma isikhawu siba sibanzi, okuncane kakhulu kungaba kuncane kuphela noma kuhlale kunjalo; akunakukhula. Weqe ukuthi wonke amanani esikhawini sangaphambilini asafakiwe uma isikhawu siba sibanzi.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ku-k = 4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 4): uma x = 0, f = 3, futhi uma x = 4, f = 3, ngakho iziphetho ezimbili zinenani elifanayo. Okuphezulu kakhulu ngu-3. Uma sandisa ku-k = 5, f = 8 ku-x = 5 iba okuphezulu kakhulu okusha.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Isibikezelo sika-Seoyeon “uma isikhawu siba sibanzi, okuphezulu kakhulu kuba kukhulu nakakhulu” kufanele silungiswe kanjani?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Ku-0 ≤ k ≤ 4, f(k) ≤ 3, ngakho okuphezulu kakhulu ngu-f(0) = 3, futhi kusukela ku-k > 4, f(k) iba nkulu kuno-3. Isibikezelo sika-Seoyeon silungile kuphela uma k < 2 kokuncane kakhulu, futhi kuphela uma k > 4 kokuphezulu kakhulu. Ibanga lapho silungile lihlukana kuye ngesimo (isikhawu).
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ngokushesha lapho k inyuka, okuphezulu kakhulu nakho kunyuka, ngakho u-Seoyeon ulungile njengoba ashilo
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuthi okuphezulu kakhulu kuhlala ku-3 uma k = 3 no-k = 4. Udinga ukuqhathanisa ukuthi amanani ka-x asanda kwengezwa anikeza okukhulu kuno-okuphezulu kakhulu okukhona yini.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Noma k inyuka kangakanani, okuphezulu kakhulu kuhlala ku-3
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Weqe ukuthi f(5) = 8 ivela ku-k = 5. Udinga ukuhlola ukuthi inani esiphethweni liqhubeka nokukhula yini.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kuze kufike ku-k = 4 okuphezulu kakhulu kuhlala ku-3, futhi kukhula kuphela ngemva kokuthi k idlula u-4
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lesi sinqumo siqhathanisa ukuthi isiphi phakathi kweziphetho ezimbili, x = 0 no-x = k, esinenani elikhulu.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.reflect: Abanye abantu baqale babikezela “okuncane kakhulu kuqhubeka nokuncipha” futhi bashintsha umqondo ngemva kokubona ithebula ngale kuka-x = 2, nabanye babikezela “kungase kuyeke” futhi bagcina lowo mbikezelo. Emgqeni owodwa, sho ukuthi yiliphi ithebula elishintshe (noma elagcina) isinqumo sakho.

z-m-38-04.title: Uma amafomula amabili ahlangabezana nawo wonke amarekhodi amathathu, ngubani okufanele simethembe?
z-m-38-04.topic: Ukukhetha ifomula ehambisana nedatha (ukuqhathanisa i-inverse proportion nomsebenzi we-quadratic)
z-m-38-04.goal: Qhathanisa izinhlobo ezimbili zamafomula adlula emaphoyintini amathathu edatha afanayo, nquma ukuthi iyiphi ifomula okufanele uyethembe nokuthi kangakanani usebenzisa isilinganiso esisha nesakhiwo sesimo, futhi usho ibanga lapho uyethemba khona.
z-m-38-04.material: Amanzi angu-12 L athululelwa ngokulinganayo emabhodleleni afanayo angu-x (u-x uyinombolo ephelele ephozithivu), futhi inani u-y (L) ebhodleleni elilodwa lilinganiswa. Amarekhodi: ngebhodlela o-1, 12 L; ngamabhodlela angu-2, 6 L; ngamabhodlela angu-3, 4 L. Abangani ababili baphakamise amafomula. UJiwon: y = 12/x (ifundwa: '12 ahlukaniswe ngo-x'). UHyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (ifundwa: '2 x isikwele ukhipha 12x ukwengeza 22'). Amanzi awavuzi, futhi ahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo phakathi kwamabhodlela.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Ukubala wena ukuhlola ukuthi idatha nemodeli ziyavumelana yini
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ukuthi ukholelwa kangakanani njengoba ubufakazi obusha bufika
z-m-38-04.thinking.2: Ukwahlukanisa lokho okuhambisana nedatha nalokho okuhambisana nesimo
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Ukuthola amanani omsebenzi (ukufaka u-x efomulini nokubala)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Ukufunda amafomula omsebenzi we-quadratic nomsebenzi we-rational u-y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: Ubudlelwano (inani lamabhodlela) × (inani ebhodleleni elilodwa) = inani eliphelele
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Ubheka kuphela amarekhodi amathathu angenhla, khetha isitatimende esifaneleka kakhulu.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-x = 1, 2, 3 kwifomula ngayinye kwezimbili futhi uqhathanise namarekhodi etafuleni.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ifomula edlula emaphoyintini amathathu iyodwa kuphela, noma kungaba khona eziningana.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: U-y=12/x ulula kakhulu, ngakho lawa marekhodi odwa anele ukuphetha ngokuthi ifomula kaJiwon ilungile
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise “ifomula ilula” njengobufakazi. Ukulula kungaba yisizathu sokukholelwa, kodwa akunqunywa idatha.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: U-y=2x²−12x+22 unama-coefficient aphelele wonke ngakho unembe kakhulu, ngakho ifomula kaHyunwoo ilungile
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: Ufune ukunemba ekubukekeni kwama-coefficient. Ukuthi ifomula ihambisana nedatha yini kungaziwa kuphela ngokufaka amanani.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Zombili izifomula ziyahambisana namarekhodi amathathu, ngakho lawa marekhodi odwa awakwazi ukutshela ukuthi iyiphi elungile
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo siyaqaphela ukuthi uma amafomula amabili ehambisana nedatha efanayo, idatha yodwa ayikwazi ukuwahlukanisa.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Ifomula edlula emaphoyintini amathathu iyodwa, ngakho eyodwa kwezimbili kumele ibe nephutha lokubala
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukholelwe ukuthi ifomula edlula emaphoyintini amathathu iyodwa. Noma umsebenzi we-quadratic udlula emaphoyintini amathathu, uhlobo olwehlukile lwefomula lungadlula emaphoyintini afanayo.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka u-x = 1, 2, 3 kunika u-12, 6, 4 kuzo zombili izifomula, okuhambisana namarekhodi. Njengoba amafomula amabili ehambisana nedatha efanayo, amarekhodi odwa awakwazi ukuwahlukanisa. Ukunquma ukuthi iyiphi ifomula okufanele uyethembe, udinga ezinye izizathu, njengesilinganiso esisha noma isakhiwo sesimo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: Ulwazi olusha lukhululeka ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, nquma ukuthi ukholelwa kangakanani kuzifomula ezimbili kushintsha kanjani.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka inani lamabhodlela eliwu-x elembuliwe kuzo zombili izifomula ukuthola amanani abikezelwe wena, futhi uwaqhathanise nenani elilinganisiwe.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: Uma inani elilinganisiwe lihluka esibikezelweni, cabanga ngamathuba womabili: ifomula ingase ingalungile, noma ukulinganisa kungase kungalungile.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: Sahlukanisa amanzi emabhodleleni angu-4 futhi salinganisa inani ebhodleleni elilodwa: kwakungu-3 L.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: Uma uqhathanisa leli nani elilinganisiwe nezibikezelo zezifomula ezimbili, uphethani ngezifomula ezimbili?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Ifomula kaJiwon ibikezela u-3 L ku-x = 4, futhi eka-Hyunwoo ibikezela u-6 L. U-3 L olinganisiwe uyavumelana nefomula kaJiwon futhi uhluke kakhulu kweka-Hyunwoo. Kunengqondo ukwethemba uhlangothi lukaJiwon ngokushesha, futhi kunengqondo nokulinganisa kanye futhi ngenxa yethuba lephutha lokulinganisa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Ukulinganisa kungase kungalungile, ngakho linganisa kanye futhi bese unquma
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Lesi sisimo esinakekelayo: ukungashesheli esiphethweni kusukela enanini elilodwa elilinganisiwe, kodwa ukufuna ukuhlola.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sikholelwa kakhulu kulo isibikezelo salo esihluke kancane kunenani elilinganisiwe.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo asihlolanga ukuthi ifomula kaHyunwoo inika inani eliyini ku-x = 4.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: Ngamabhodlela angu-6 kwalinganiswa u-2 L, futhi ngamabhodlela angu-12 kwalinganiswa u-1 L. (Kuze kube manje, amarekhodi angu-5.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: Iyiphi indlela efanele yokusho ukukholelwa kwakho efomulini kaJiwon u-y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Njengoba idatha ikhula, ukukholelwa kwakho efomulini kaJiwon kuyakhula. Kodwa amarekhodi angu-5 odwa awakwazi ukuqinisekisa u-x ngamunye. Uma kukhona isizathu (isakhiwo sesimo), ukukholelwa kwakho kungaqiniswa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Wonke amarekhodi angu-5 ayelungile, ngakho singaphetha ngokuthi kulungile kunoma yiliphi inani eliphelele elipozithivu u-x
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Unwebisa “amarekhodi ayelungile kahlanu” ezimeni zonke. Amanani ka-x angalinganiswanga awakahlolwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Noma inani lamarekhodi ahambisanayo likhula, ukukholelwa kwethu akushintshi nhlobo
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Lokhu akucabangi ngokuthi isilinganiso esisha siyibufakazi obukhomba ohlangothini olufanayo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Ukukholelwa kwethu sekukhulile ngoba amarekhodi angu-5 ahambisana, kodwa isizathu esehlukile sisadingeka ukuze kubambe emanani ka-x angalinganiswanga
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo sithi ubufakazi buqinisa ukukholelwa, kodwa kudingeka isizathu ukujwayelekisa ezimeni zonke.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: Uma uphindaphinda inani lamabhodlela ngenani ebhodleleni elilodwa, uhlala uthola inani eliphelele elingu-12 L. Lokhu ngoba amanzi awavuzi futhi ahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo phakathi kwamabhodlela.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Wazi lokhu, ungasho ini ngefomula kaJiwon u-y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Njengoba u-x·y = 12, u-y = 12/x uvela ngqo esimeni, hhayi emarekhodini. Ngakho singasho ukuthi ibamba kunoma yiliphi inani eliphelele elipozithivu u-x ngaphansi kwesicabango sokuthi “amanzi awavuzi futhi ahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo.” Uma isicabango siphuka (uma amanzi evuza), ifomula nayo iyashintsha.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Hhayi ngenxa yamarekhodi kuphela kodwa ngenxa yesakhiwo sesimo, singasho u-y=12/x kunoma yiliphi inani eliphelele elipozithivu u-x inqobo nje uma amanzi engavuzi futhi ehlukaniswa ngokulinganayo
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sibeka ibanga lokukholelwa kusetshenziswa zombili izizathu ndawonye: ubufakazi bedatha nesakhiwo sesimo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Sisadinga ukuncika kumarekhodi angu-5 kuphela, futhi isakhiwo sesimo asiyona isisekelo
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Ushiye ukuthi ubudlelwano obuvela esimeni (umkhiqizo ungashintshi) bunquma ngqo ifomula.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Ifomula kaHyunwoo idlula emaphoyintini amathathu ngenhlanhla, ngakho ifomula kaJiwon ayilungile
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Ifomula kaHyunwoo edlula emaphoyintini amathathu ayisho ukuthi ifomula kaJiwon ayilungile. Ifomula yakhe ayihambisani nesakhiwo emanani ka-x amanye.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.reflect: Ku-s1 wahlulela “asikwazi ukuzihlukanisa,” futhi abanye bashintsha lokho ngemva kokubona isilinganiso samabhodlela angu-4, kanti abanye bakugcina ngo-“linganisa kanye futhi.” Sho ukuthi isizathu sokuthi isahlulelo sakho sashintsha noma sahlala sasiwu-inani elilinganisiwe noma isakhiwo sesimo.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.prompt: UHyunwoo wathi, “Noma kunjalo, i-quadratic ihambisane namarekhodi amathathu, ngakho ingalunga kamuva.” Chaza izizathu zokuthi kungani ifomula kaHyunwoo ingahambisani nalesi simo, usebenzisa okungenani inombolo eyodwa.
